leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a sliding window algorithm to track fruit types in baskets
Initialize and update a frequency map for fruit counts within the window
Manipulate window boundaries to maintain at most two distinct fruit types
Construct logic to calculate the maximum number of fruits collected
Apply conditional statements to handle basket capacity constraints
Integrate loop structures to iterate through the fruit array efficiently
Render the final solution by returning the maximum window length
